existing_rows_audit.detail: The Dublin office is real (1st Floor, 76 Sir John Rogerson's Quay — https://www.hudsonrivertrading.com/offices/), but HRT's live Greenhouse board (72 reqs, board slug 'wehrtyou') has NO C++ or software engineering role in Dublin. The only two Dublin postings are Electronic Trading Support Engineer (gh_jid=6575600) and Junior Electronic Trading Support Engineer (gh_jid=7116458), both support/ops rather than C++ development and both out of the four tracks. The row's comp figure (€120–180k) and the 'Reported' verification were not sourced to any posting.

The experienced-hire 'Algo Developer' req (gh_jid=96224) is posted for New York and Singapore ONLY — not London. London's only Algorithm Developer openings are the student-gated campus reqs 'Algorithm Developer (Quant Research & Trading) – 2027 Grads' (gh_jid=8052050) and '– 2027 PhDs' (gh_jid=8059845). So an experienced London Algo Developer seat does not currently exist, and the row's £180–280k figure is not stated anywhere on HRT's site.

Singapore does have a live experienced C++ req, but the exact posted title is 'Software Engineer - Low Level (C++)' (https://www.hudsonrivertrading.com/careers/job/?gh_jid=1229082). It is also NOT student-gated — the row's 'GRAD REQ STUDENT-GATED' verdict is wrong for this req; it requires only a bachelor's degree and C++ experience. A second Singapore C++ req, 'Software Engineer - Distributed Compute' (gh_jid=7566004), also exists. The SGD 300–420k figure is not stated on either posting.

Out of scope for this pass (US), but for the record the req is live as 'Software Engineer (C++ or Python) – 2027 Grads' (gh_jid=8052122) covering Austin/Chicago/London/New York/Singapore, and the posting does state 'Base salary for US is $300,000', which supports the row's comp. The student gate is verbatim and real.

Out of scope for this pass (US). No req titled 'Core Software Engineer' exists on HRT's board; the nearest live Austin C++ req is 'Software Engineer – C++' (gh_jid=7392942), which states a 200,000–300,000 USD base range, not the row's $380–470k.
Out of scope for this pass (US). Same finding as Austin — no 'Core Software Engineer' title exists on HRT's board; the live Chicago C++ req is 'Software Engineer – C++' (gh_jid=7392942).

notes:
Method: https://www.hudsonrivertrading.com/careers/ renders its listings via JavaScript and returned 'no open positions' to a plain fetch, so I enumerated the full board through HRT's own Greenhouse feed (board slug 'wehrtyou'), which returned 72 live reqs, and read the full posting body for each in-scope one. All role URLs above are on hudsonrivertrading.com and return HTTP 200. Offices were confirmed against https://www.hudsonrivertrading.com/offices/ (14 offices).

Office findings: HRT has NO Tokyo office and no continental-EU office of any kind — Dublin is the firm's only EU seat, and it currently has zero in-track openings. Shanghai and Hong Kong offices both exist; Shanghai has ZERO postings on the board (so nothing to report there), while Hong Kong has exactly one, the low-level C++ req. There is no Mandarin requirement anywhere in the APAC postings I read — both the Hong Kong and Singapore low-level C++ reqs state 'Must be fluent (reading, writing and conversing) in English'.

Student gates: the '2027 Grads' / '2027 PhDs' postings are genuinely student-gated with verbatim language ('full-time undergraduate or masters student ... eligible for full-time roles in 2027'), which the candidate does not meet. Crucially, the existing spreadsheet applied that gate to every HRT row — that is wrong. The experienced-hire reqs (Software Engineer – C++, Software Engineer - Low Level (C++), Software Engineer - Distributed Compute, Algo Developer, all four AI reqs, Research Engineer) carry no graduation-year gate at all and are the correct application targets.

Comp: figures given are quoted verbatim from the postings and are USD BASE ranges with the caveat '(or local equivalent)' — HRT does not publish London/Singapore/Hong Kong local numbers, so do not treat these as GBP/SGD/HKD totals. The Singapore- and Hong Kong-only reqs carry no salary language at all, so comp_local is left empty for those.

Excluded as out-of-track (documented so the gap is visible, not because I failed to find them): a family of London/Singapore Linux-sysadmin and network reqs — Trading Systems Engineer (7+ yrs), Junior Trading Systems Engineer, Systems Engineer - R&D (5+ yrs), Senior Network Engineer - Low Latency Trading (5–10 yrs), HPC Network Engineer (10+ yrs), Quantitative Latency Engineer (Python/data-analytics rather than systems), Data Production Engineer (data eng), Software Engineer - Python (London and Singapore), Fullstack Developer, and the Dublin/Singapore/London Electronic Trading Support Engineer roles. Also excluded: the Summer 2027 internships (under 6 months and student-gated) and the hardware reqs (Design Verification Engineer, Physical Design Engineer, Experienced Hardware Design Engineer), which are RTL/ASIC rather than C++ or ML.
